name: Lockfile Integrity Policy
description: Lockfile must be present and complete. CI fails on missing or incomplete lockfile.
purpose: Ensure every build uses a verified lockfile so dependency resolution is deterministic and tamper-evident across all environments.
acceptanceCriteria: CI pipeline includes a lockfile integrity check step before any dependency resolution.
Missing lockfile causes an immediate CI failure with a clear error message.
Lockfile hash is pinned in repository configuration and verified on each build.
Lockfile completeness is validated (no unmatched entries, no dangling references).
Policy applies to all package managers used in the project (npm, pip, cargo, etc.).
Lockfile drift detection alerts when working tree differs from lockfile state.
